note: Off-the-shelf actuator specifications for Phase 6A (exploratory axial CAD). Every number is transcribed from the manufacturer's published datasheet, cited per entry. These REPLACE the freeze's placeholder '3 x 75 g hobby servo' allowance (docs/design_freeze_axial.md 4.4, open risk). Nothing here is qualified for this application; the temperature ratings in particular are datasheet limits, not analysis results.

actuonix_p16_50_256.type: miniature linear actuator (stainless lead screw, planetary gearbox, self-locking)
actuonix_p16_50_256.source: Actuonix P16 datasheet Rev B (2016), P16 Specifications table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/actuonix/Actuonix+P16+Datasheet.pdf

vigv.drive: servo crank arm 5 mm driving the unison ring tangentially
vigv.rationale: ring force 57 N x 5 mm arm = 0.285 N m = 36 % of the 0.80 N m rated torque; servo travel asin(1.57/5) = 18.3 deg, inside the standard +/-85 deg. Compressor-face static temperature ~16 C, well inside the -30..+70 C rating.

bleed.drive: 2:1 crank pair to the band valve
bleed.rationale: band torque 1.02 N m / 2 = 0.51 N m = 64 % of rated; servo travel 2 x 20 deg = 40 deg. TEMPERATURE NOT COMPLIANT: the stage-3 manifold is at 433 K (160 C) against a +70 C rating; a thermal standoff is required and has not been designed.

nozzle.drive: 22.5:1 reduction (screwjack or gear stage) to the sync ring
nozzle.rationale: NOT COMPLIANT. Total flap hinge moment 27.0 N m at the closed/dash condition. Holding it on the 1.20 N m rated torque needs 22.5:1, which makes the servo travel 22.5 x 14.07 deg = 317 deg: only the optional 330 deg extended-travel version reaches it, and the 22.5:1 reduction is a screw or gear stage that is NOT in the 0.279 kg flap/ring/hinge estimate. On peak torque (3.0 N m) a 9:1 bellcrank holds it with zero margin, which is not a design. TEMPERATURE NOT COMPLIANT by a wide margin: the actuator sits beside a 937 K jet pipe against a +70 C rating.
nozzle.alternative_considered: actuonix_p16_50_256: self-locking, so it holds without power, but its 300 N lift / 500 N static is below the 729 N sync-ring load of the modelled linkage (two units would be needed, 0.190 kg) and its -10..+50 C rating is worse.
